account_id.description: The expense or asset account the line costs.

gst_code.description: The GST code for purchases the supplier is expected to charge.

quantity.description: How many, an exact decimal with up to 6 decimals.

unit_price.description: The price of one before GST, in the order's currency, an exact decimal with up to 6 decimals. The line's amount is RND-LINE: quantity × unit price rounded to the currency's minor units, half away from zero.
